name: Webhook registration with push_notification_config.authentication over bearer (unsigned); seller supports request signing but operation is NOT in required_for
spec_reference: #webhook-callbacks Downgrade and injection resistance — deprecated condition (b): MUST require 9421 when authentication is present and legacy_hmac_fallback is true. Deprecated in 3.x, removed in 4.0; a seller with legacy_hmac_fallback false rejects the registration with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE instead.
$comment: Transitional vector for deprecated condition (b) of request_signature_required (adcp#7563), removed in 4.0. Grade it only for agents that advertise webhook_signing.legacy_hmac_fallback: true; a runner skips it (not a failure) when the flag is false or the webhook_signing block is absent, because condition (b) applies only while legacy HMAC is available and such a seller's task handler rejects a registration carrying authentication with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, not request_signature_required. Functional storyboards MUST NOT send push_notification_config.authentication on spend-committing steps, so a seller is not forced onto one side of this vector by an unrelated create step.
